reasons: Financing/custody disclosures are event/context features, not direct price signals.
The $29m note has no traced XRP purchase.
The 388.9m in-kind contribution is not open-market demand.
The $9.7m related-party debt repayment status is unknown.
The ELOC is contingent capacity, not actual drawdown.
The S-1 records a separate $49,995 residual-cash XRP purchase at closing but does not disclose its XRP quantity; do not infer total holdings from only the large disclosed lots.
